identity.name: NH3
identity.normalization: Divide HITRAN/ExoMol total nuclear-spin Q by 24. Do not add another symmetry, inversion or electronic multiplicity factor. This is a thermal ortho/para equilibrium convention, not a frozen ratio.

NASA.reference: Gurvich,1989 pt1 p354 pt2 p219. Haar,1968.
NASA.inspection: Pinned CEA record and source header inspected. Historical Gurvich/Haar originals not newly inspected; not required for this source-only merge.

ATcT.inspection: Pinned same-version N, H, NH3 gas records; independent root audit confirms balanced D0. Complete covariance network not audited.
ATcT.uncertainty: No independent-error quadrature is claimed; atomic/molecular network errors can be correlated.

CoYuTe.inspection: Full author PDF acquired; methods, completeness Figure2 and Table1 states inspected. Official Zenodo 20200730 .pf and .def acquired. Full 5,095,730-state distribution not downloaded or summed.
CoYuTe.energy_zero: Formal J=0 vibrational zero has forbidden A1 symmetry. Published allowed J=0 inversion partner is at 0.793374 cm-1; distributed Q(1K)=3.8321 agrees with 12 exp(-c2 E). Shifting Q to allowed-state zero also requires shifting the energy anchor; source conventions are not silently aligned.
CoYuTe.completeness: Line-list opacity completeness concerns its lower-state cutoff, not automatically the sum of every distributed state. Paper cites a ~0.99 effective/full Q ratio at1500K. Neither .pf availability to2000K nor .def metadata establishes complete4000K thermodynamic moments.

SousaSilva2014.inspection: Full PDF acquired; methods, moment definitions, convergence, Table1 and AppendixA/B inspected. Table1 visually checked. Separate electronic 1K Q and first/second-moment tables not acquired: publisher supplement returned403.
SousaSilva2014.cutoff_caveat: This source labels a dissociation cutoff. It is not the full ATcT atomization N+3H energy; do not replace the latter with it.
SousaSilva2014.fit_policy: Printed fit is diagnostic only: its296K result disagrees with the explicitly reported direct sum by more than declared fit tolerance and last-digit rounding. Obtain supplement or corrected coefficients before treating it as a direct-sum replacement. Do not infer Cp by differentiating this unreconciled fit.

printed_locations.coefficients: Table1 printedp73, PDFp8; independently visually inspected by root and molecule reviewer

SousaSilva2014.erratum_search: Targeted DOI/title corrigendum/erratum web search on2026-11-04 found no correction. No claim of absence.

TIPS2025.inspection: Full PDF acquired previously; Table1, conventions and section3.3 NH3 methods reinspected. Pinned official HAPI TIPS2021/TIPS2025 arrays M=11,I=1 extracted exactly by AST.
TIPS2025.method_at_and_above_crossover: McDowell analytical rotation times harmonic-oscillator vibrational product approximation, not a newly complete variational state sum.
TIPS2025.selection_caveat: Newest publication does not establish superiority over NASA or converged dedicated NH3 thermodynamics. High-temperature source spread is not a calibrated uncertainty.

required_for_candidate: Obtain the electronic NH3 Q, Q first moment and Q second moment supplement to10.1016/j.jqsrt.2014.03.012, or author-confirmed corrected data; resolve the printed fit mismatch.
Compare direct thermodynamic moments where converged, then quantify or extend rotational/vibrational tail beyond3000K if retaining a4000K production endpoint.
Align formal/lowest-allowed energy zero with the existing ATcT anchor, keep isotope translation separate, and validate any candidate with fixed-network finite substitutions.
not_merge_requirements: All historical Gurvich/Haar originals or all original ATcT network papers.
New atmospheric observations or full covariance determination for a source-only record.
follow_up.classification: Source-only review can merge with unchanged curated. A full-domain replacement is scientifically unresolved, not demonstrated unnecessary.

TIPS2021.inspection: Full user-provided PDF available; section3.11 NH3 inspected.
TIPS2021.method: Direct sum of ExoMol14NH3 terms, described in2021 as converged to6000K. HAPI2021 arrays reproduced, but2025 changes the high-T construction. No raw moments were obtained here to establish6000K completeness independently.
TIPS2021.independence: TIPS direct sums and2014/CoYuTe share ExoMol ancestry and are not independent experimental validation.
